training: Use training RGB only, the original and adapted D-FINE decoder heads, a mirrored full view and overlapping windows at two relative scales along the forward camera corridor. Learn proposal verification from one-to-one evaluation-sized visible person, bicycle, motorcycle and truck boxes, using object appearance, shape and cross-view evidence. Rider and bicycle proposals may also be suggested by geometry learned from paired training instance IDs. No labels, scene identifiers, simulator state, expected counts or weather at inference.
selection: Calibrate four class confidence thresholds on the same 699 archived validation frames and the 81 native exposures at each of site 90 and independent development site 608. Keep every parent prediction. Require each native development site's unchanged absolute and YOLOX-S relative gates and both archive groups' original overall precision and recall floors. Retain the bus recovery rule and passenger car detector.
holdout: Geometry selected before training and evaluation. Site 1576 is on independent road 40, at least 75 m from earlier sites and road-disjoint. Model-free preparation must pass. Freeze all inference parameters and development results before one 81-frame holdout acquisition. All 6 original absolute class thresholds, aggregate thresholds, coverage, near person, negative FP and paired YOLOX-S checks remain in force.
